logEnabled.description: Log online compaction decisions and savings

cacheWriteReadRatio.description: KV cache write-to-read cost ratio. auto derives it from ctx.model.cost

summaryThinkingLevel.description: Thinking level cap for compaction summary requests (only lowers, never raises; the session level is restored afterwards). inherit keeps the session level

keepRecentTokens.description: Native compaction keep-recent window size (also used for archiveTokens estimation and the nativeCompactionFeasible precheck). Defaults to inheriting pi's compaction.keepRecentTokens setting (20000 when unset).

enabled.description: Enable hot/cold-tiered packing of large tool outputs
Enable fidelity-preserving refinement of long test logs

logEnabled.description: Log refinement comparisons, durations and fallbacks

model.description: Dedicated lightweight Reducer model (provider/model). Defaults to the current model and logs an economy hint

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound for the synchronous interception timeout; defaults to 5s to avoid blocking

localOnly.description: Archive long logs locally only and skip model refinement

jev.description: jev decision layer (RFC docs/rfc-jev-integration.md): optional System One classification calls, fail-open at each point

enabled.description: Enable the jev decision layer (calls are only made once apiKey is configured)

baseUrl.description: API base URL override (proxy/gateway); defaults to https://api.typesafe.ai

model.description: Pinned versioned model id; aliases drift silently and skew calibration thresholds

timeoutMs.description: Total budget per call (hard kill via AbortController; the SDK has no total-budget mode)

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence for accepting a Choice/Score answer; below it the answer is treated as unanswered

apiKey.description: API key. Resolution order: PIER_JEV_API_KEY env var > this field > TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var
